name: Laer (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Laer (a black eagle taking flight on yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Münster of 5 March 1970 the municipality of Laer was granted the right to bear arms and an official seal; by deed of 28 November 1983 it was further granted the right to bear a flag.

features.role: Laer arms — black eagle on yellow
